International legal qualifications are explicitly welcome.* Several years of relevant legal advisory experience, ideally gained within an international corporate environment.* Strong knowledge of ESG, energy, fuels and/or related regulatory matters. Experience in aviation or energy is an advantage.* Extensive experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements.* The ability to analyse regulatory change and translate it into practical recommendations and implementation approaches.* Fluent written and spoken English, including the ability to negotiate effectively. German and additional languages are advantageous.* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management capabilities and the confidence to work independently in a rapidly evolving international regulatory environment.       Why Join This Role?
